settings.label: Size chart link
settings.info: Default for all products. A product can override it with a custom.size_chart metafield (page reference or URL).

settings.label: Custom colors
settings.info: Maps a Color/Colour option value to a HEX color or an image filename already uploaded to Settings > Files. Format: <Color>: <HEX color or filename>, one per line. Used when a color has no native Shopify swatch or metaobject entry.

settings.label: Show free shipping bar
settings.info: 是否展示购物车包邮进度条

settings.label: Show tiered discount bar
settings.info: 是否显示多件多折进度条，需要在商店设置 metafields.custom.tiered_discount 中配置多件多折规则

settings.label: Tiered offer labels
settings.info: 多件多折商品组的标签，多个用 | 分隔，例如 Best Sellers|New Arrival

settings.label: Tiered offer text
settings.info: 多件多折商品组标签右侧的文案

settings.label: Other offer labels
settings.info: 不参与多件多折的商品组标签，多个用 | 分隔，例如 New|Sale

settings.label: Other offer text
settings.info: 不参与多件多折的商品组标签右侧的文案
settings.default: Not part of the Best Sellers offer

settings.info: 弹窗配置：点击购物车里的 ⓘ 弹出，展示当前店铺所有优惠

settings.label: Image (desktop)
settings.info: PC 端优惠图片，建议宽度 960px。图片的 alt 文字请在 Files 中填写（读屏软件会读取）

settings.label: Image (mobile)
settings.info: 移动端优惠图片，建议宽度 750px。未上传时使用 PC 端图片

settings.label: Rules detail
settings.default: Offers apply automatically — no code needed. If an item qualifies for more than one offer, we always apply the one that saves you the most. One offer per item — offers don’t stack.

settings.label: Default store image
settings.info: Used when a store has no photo available.

settings.label: Hidden stores (one per line)
settings.info: Enter a store's English name exactly as it appears on the Find a Store page (case and spacing don't matter) to hide it. Takes effect immediately, no code changes needed. Example: Shanghai Songjiang Incity
